attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 2
defer tadi-farm adult 2
</plan>
COST: 120

Notes:
- Only Tarkeshwar shelter is a valid evacuation point, since Myagang temple has not been designated. Every rescued person must be unloaded there.
- The two adults at Tadi farm are deferred because the Tadi round trip adds about 64 driving minutes, which costs more than the 40-minute deferral penalty. If all 8 people should be rescued in this wave, the plan is: take 3 elderly and 1 adult from Myagang, then 2 adults from Myagang, then the 2 Tadi adults via Myagang–Tadi (22 min each way). That costs 124 with no deferrals, 4 minutes more than the plan above.
- The Shivapuri farm–Benighat farm road is flooded but still listed as usable, so the plan does not depend on it.
